title: Ask the AI for current information

entries.text: Ask the AI for current information

The AI's training data has a cutoff. For anything more recent, current library versions, latest news, who shipped what last week: it can search the web and weave the result into your doc. The search runs on the instance's European search provider; your AI provider writes the answer. It links the sources it used, so you can verify before publishing.

entries.caption: Click into the AI prompt bar
The prompt bar lifts and glows, ready for your prompt.
Type a question that needs current info
Your prompt is ready. Asking for the "latest" release tells the AI to search the web.
The AI is working, it searches the web, then writes the answer into the doc.
The AI searched the web, found the current Vue.js release, and wrote the note into the doc, with a link to its source.
